questions.question: Which of the following queue types has highest execution priority upon completion of current call stack frame?
questions.explanation: The JavaScript engine empties the entire microtask queue before processing the next macrotask from the event loop.

questions.question: What is the return value of Promise.all([]) when given an empty array?
options: A Promise that stays pending forever
A Promise fulfilled synchronously with an empty array []
questions.explanation: Promise.all() resolves synchronously to an empty array when passed an empty iterable.

questions.question: In the V8 engine, how are closures allocated in memory?
options: On the Heap inside Context objects
questions.explanation: Variables captured by closures outlive the stack frame and are allocated on the V8 heap inside Context objects.
